subject: Business Models
title: Cable TV Bundles
description: A short lesson to help you apply Cable TV Bundles.

hook.text: You wanted ESPN but paid for 200 channels you never watched. That's bundling.

buildup.text: Cable companies bundled popular and niche channels together, forcing customers to buy the whole package.

discovery.text: Bundling works because it captures more consumer surplus. Each person values different channels highly.

twist.text: Streaming 'unbundled' cable—then rebundled: Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+ cost more together than cable did.

climax.text: Unbundling and rebundling is a cycle. Industries unbundle for disruption, then rebundle for profit.

punchline.text: Cut the cord, then subscribe to five apps. Bundles always return.

quiz.question: Why does bundling capture more consumer surplus?
